card.name: Commas and 'and' before next treatment
card.fires_on: Commas, 'and' or 'of' that come right after a drug or a failed first step, just before the next drug or treatment is named. Seen in seizure-control lists (phenobarbital, phenytoin) and in 'if ineffective' phrases.

modes.label: Comma in drug lists
modes.description: A comma after a named drug or an 'if ineffective' clause, just before the next drug.

modes.label: Joining word before a next item
modes.description: An 'and' or 'of' that links to the next action or drug in a sequence.
modes.example: soaking him in gasoline,<< and>> burning him to death.
